questions.question: Which equation relates the angle $\theta$ between nonzero vectors to their dot product?
questions.explanation: For nonzero vectors, the defining relation is $x\cdot y=\|x\|\|y\|\cos\theta$, equivalently $\cos\theta=(x\cdot y)/(\|x\|\|y\|)$.
